stories.title: A Lightweight Velocity Correction Framework for Improving Instruction Following in Few-Step Text-to-Image Generation

stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: HorizonNav: Geometry-Guided Video Diffusion for Anticipatory 3D Robot Navigation
stories.summary: We present HorizonNav, a video diffusion-based framework for anticipatory robot navigation that transforms a single RGB image and a text prompt into a geometrically aligned representation of plausible surrounding 3D space.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Studying the Effects of Task Diversity Using Small Mathematical Worlds
stories.summary: Basic mathematical tasks like modular addition have been a valuable tool for illuminating aspects of neural network behavior that are challenging to see in noisy, unverifiable, large-scale, real-world settings. These studies have typically focused on a single task.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Accelerating Linear Bandits with Persistent Candidate Sets
stories.summary: Exhaustive optimistic scoring can make action selection costly in linear bandits with a large fixed set of $K$ actions, requiring $\mathcal{O}(K)$ score evaluations per round.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Neural Surrogate Modeling of Ultrasonic Wave Propagation in Heterogeneous Media
stories.summary: Neural surrogates provide computationally efficient auto-regressive modeling of wave propagation, enabling e.g. fast inverse solutions.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Space Over Statistic, Retraining Over Ranking: Auditing Training Labels Under Label-Only Backdoors
stories.summary: Some backdoor attacks never touch an image. FLIP only changes labels: on CIFAR-10, flipping 3% of them makes a ResNet-32 send 99.7% of triggered source-class images to the attacker's class.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Rethinking Relative Policy Differences Transfer of On-Policy Distillation
stories.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a target policy on its own rollouts using token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, but typically relies on the teacher being substantially more capable than the target.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: GlucoPRISM: Protocol-Supervised Pretraining for Cross-Cohort Glucose Transfer
stories.summary: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) foundation models encode each day as one vector that mixes who the person is, what happened that day and how the sensor measured it, so measurement differences travel with the representation into new cohorts.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: CopRoute: Dependence-Aware Conformal Routing for Language Models
stories.summary: Set-based language model routing aims to increase the coverage of the event where at least one model answers a query correctly while controlling the number of inference calls made.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Collective Autonomous Vehicle Routing Needs Social Awareness for Coexistence with Human Drivers
stories.summary: Collective Autonomous Vehicle (AV) route choices in real-world traffic networks can create externalities for Human-Driven Vehicles (HDVs), as routes that benefit AVs may increase travel times for other road users.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Localized Generative Design of Ship Hulls with Diffusion Models and High-Fidelity Assessment
stories.summary: Practical ship design requires localized refinement and performance evaluation. This paper presents a reward-directed diffusion framework for localized hull optimization.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: MORAD: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Objective Rewards for RNA Inverse Design
stories.summary: We introduce MORAD, an online reinforcement learning framework for backbone-conditioned RNA diffusion models that trains a single shared policy across diverse target backbones.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Prediction Is Not a Sufficient Memory State
stories.summary: A memory that reproduces every current prediction may still have forgotten how to learn from the next observation. We characterize this distinction for exact cumulative learning and attention.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: AlphaNIST: Emergent Assembly Skills from Binary Task Rewards
stories.summary: The NIST Assembly Task Board #1 remains a challenging benchmark for learning-based methods in robotic manipulation. Over short horizons, it demands precise, contact-rich control of small, tight-fitting parts.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Automated Detection and Encoding of Cartographic Signs in Historical Maps
stories.summary: Symbols and icons in archival maps represent an expansive source of evidence for historical geography.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Multi-Stream Attention Residuals
stories.summary: Attention Residuals (AttnRes) enables content-dependent retrieval over network depth, which can be viewed as single-stream softmax attention along the depth axis.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: WoodBR-Cross: A public wood-image dataset and individual-tree-disjoint benchmark for species identification
stories.summary: Wood-image benchmarks can yield optimistic estimates when images from the same tree occur in both training and test sets.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: What Do Audio-Language Judges of Generated Music Listen For? Four Probes with Controls from Expert Ratings
stories.summary: Open audio-language models are used as judges of generated music: given a clip and its text prompt, the model rates the clip, and the judge is validated by how well its ratings correlate with expert ratings.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: What Should Embodied Agents Remember? Benchmarking and Evaluating Memory Modality for Embodied Agents
stories.summary: Memory allows large language model (LLM) agents to use past experience, often stored as textual records, when responding to requests.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Understanding Mamba-3 Through Oscillatory Dynamics
stories.summary: Mamba-3 introduces input-dependent rotations into recurrent state updates, but their contribution beyond state retention remains unclear.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Amortized Counterfactual Prediction with Graph Neural Networks
stories.summary: Counterfactual inference asks how an observed outcome might have differed under different circumstances, such as whether a patient would have recovered had they received a different treatment.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Shared Canonical Component Removal Beyond Expert Views
stories.summary: In clinical practice, experts often begin by converting raw inputs into a set of expert features before making a decision.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Multi-Source and Multi-Dimensional Information Fusion in Resource-Constrained Edge Networks
stories.summary: Multi-source semantic information fusion enables edge networks to support global inference using observations collected by distributed terminals.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: CASTER: Formalizing Zero-Shot Manipulation from Synthetic Videos as Constrained Optimization
stories.summary: Prior research on learning from humans often requires real human demonstrations. But advances in video generation models offer a new paradigm: we can now prompt these generators to make synthetic videos of the task.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: OpenPA: Forced-alignment-free Multi-granular Pronunciation Assessment with Mixed-transcript Adaptation
stories.summary: Recent advances in automatic pronunciation assessment (APA) have driven a shift from scripted to free-form assessment.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Humanize Olympiad Agents: A Multi-Session Workflow for Olympiad Problem Solving with Solve, Review, Wiki, Verify
stories.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly improving on long-horizon scientific and olympiad tasks. Recent systems have produced a Lean-formalized resolution of the Navier--Stokes problem and autonomous solutions to four open questions in the Erd\H{o}s Conjectures database.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: A Distributional Framework for Behavioral Characterization and Risk Management of Large Language Models
stories.summary: Large language models are stochastic by nature. Repeated executions under the same experimental conditions may produce different responses.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: PDE-PFN: Prior-Data Fitted Neural PDE Solver
stories.summary: Motivated by the success of large language models (LLMs) with broad generalizability and robustness to noisy or unreliable pre-training data, we explore in-context prediction of PDE solution fields using approximate pre-training data.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Behind-the-Meter Photovoltaic Visibility from Net Smart Meters: Deployment Regimes and Operational Insights
stories.summary: Distribution operators need visibility of behind-the-meter photovoltaic (PV) generation, yet most residential customers are observed only through net smart meters.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: GeoFitBench-LLM: A Benchmark for Assessing Large Language Models' Capabilities in Geospatial Data Requirements Elicitation for Geo-Analytic Tasks
stories.summary: Large language models are becoming central to GeoAI systems, yet their evaluation rarely considers the elicitation of geospatial data requirements.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: MOSAIC: Multi-Scale Object-Centric Slot Adaptation with Image-Guided Prototype Conditioning for Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution
stories.summary: Pretrained diffusion Transformers provide powerful generative priors for image restoration, yet adapting them to structure-sensitive tasks remains challenging.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Reflect-VLA: Internalizing Reflective Guidance via Dual-Path On-Policy Self-Distillation for Autonomous Driving
stories.summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) substantially improves planning performance in autonomous-driving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Human2Dex: Dexterous Robot Learning from Wrist-Centric Human Demonstrations
stories.summary: Collecting dexterous manipulation demonstrations for each robot hand requires repeated task-specific data acquisition.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: When LiDAR Fades, Radar Takes Over: LiDAR Reliability-Aware Adaptive Localization Under Airborne Obscurants
stories.summary: LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) is widely used for real-time localization and mapping, but its reliability can degrade substantially in subterranean environments affected by smoke, dust, and other airborne obscurants, whereas radar remains comparatively robust.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Measurable Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting with Joint Region and Depth Supervision for Interactive Building Inspection
stories.summary: Image-based 3D reconstruction provides a scalable representation for building inspection and maintenance.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Lightweight Time-Frequency Vibration Sensing for Consumer Device Condition Monitoring
stories.summary: Consumer rotating devices, including washing machines, air conditioners, electric fans, robotic vacuum cleaners, and home fitness equipment, increasingly rely on vibration sensing for intelligent condition monitoring and predictive maintenance.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: What Egocentric Video Embeddings Encode and How to Combine Them with Inertial Sensors for Human Activity Recognition
stories.summary: Egocentric video and body-worn inertial sensors are increasingly recorded together, and the video is usually encoded by pretrained models.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Evolving Creatives with Clicks: CTR-Driven Advertising image Editing via Attribute Disentanglement and Preference Alignment
stories.summary: The optimization objective for e-commerce advertising creatives has shifted from aesthetic quality to online business metrics like click-through rate (CTR).
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: When Faster Decisions Do Not Make Better Agents: An Empirical Study of Jev in Agent Workflows
stories.summary: AI agents depend on repeated decisions to accomplish tasks, with large language models (LLMs) commonly serving as their core decision makers. The recent emergence of Jev offers an opportunity to make these decisions faster and at lower cost.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: WaveMark: Robust Wavelet-Domain Image Watermarking for Diffusion Models
stories.summary: Image watermarking enables provenance tracing for photorealistic images generated by diffusion models. However, state-of-the-art (SOTA) removal attacks can suppress embedded signals with little perceptual degradation.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: RESCUE: Is This Alarm Worth Acting On? Counterfactual Evaluation of VLA Runtime Monitors
stories.summary: Runtime failure monitors for robot policies are typically evaluated by how accurately they distinguish failed from successful executions.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Detection of extremely rare dead cells in fluorescence microscopy images
stories.summary: Dead cell detection in fluorescence microscopy is essential for phenotypic screening and drug efficacy assessment. However, automated identification remains challenging due to signal variability, optical artifacts, and colocalization ambiguities across multiple channels.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: GraftOOD: Grafting Out-of-Distribution Exemplars into Advantage-Weighted Rectification for Video Reward Optimization
stories.summary: Video reward optimization can increase proxy rewards while reducing video dynamics, a mismatch we identify as \emph{motion collapse}, including under a video-level motion-quality reward.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization: Unifying LLM RL Algorithms from the Perspective of Divergence
stories.summary: Reinforcement learning has become the foundational paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: CoGameReg: Cooperative-Game-Based Collaborative Semi-Supervised Regression for Seismic Reservoir Property Prediction
stories.summary: Accurate estimation of reservoir properties from seismic data remains challenging when well-log labels are sparse but three-dimensional seismic observations are abundant.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Calibration in One Go: Jointly Learning Accurate and Calibrated Neural Networks
stories.summary: Neural networks (NNs), while highly flexible and versatile, are often poorly calibrated. Post-hoc calibration methods adjust the outputs of an already trained model using a separate calibration dataset and additional calibration parameters.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: CliQ-RRG: Clinical-Knowledge Guided Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment for QA-Style Radiology Report Generation
stories.summary: Radiology reports are essential for diagnostic reasoning and patient care, yet their manual preparation is time-consuming and cognitively demanding.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Domain Adaptation of SAM 2.1 for Building-Component Segmentation in Image-Based 3D Reconstruction
stories.summary: 3D reconstruction of building components using image-based scanning requires appropriate segmentation of the objects in the 2D building images.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: SmartSalesBench: A Resistance-Aware Multi-Turn Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Sales Agents
stories.summary: We present SmartSalesBench, the first multi-turn conversational benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate large language model (LLM) sales agents against psychologically grounded, resistant buyer personas.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: The Limits of Query Monitoring against Distributed Model Extraction
stories.summary: Model providers now face distillation campaigns run through thousands of accounts, each of which looks like an ordinary user. When network and payment metadata cannot link those accounts, the only evidence left is what they ask.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Inverse Synthesis of Shock Time Series from Shock Response Spectra Using Ensembles of Conditional Variational Autoencoders
stories.summary: The shock response spectrum (SRS) characterizes the peak responses of single-degree-of-freedom systems to transient acceleration.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Decoding Register Tokens Preserves Global Scene Details
stories.summary: Pretrained vision transformers learn structured image representations spanning spatial patch tokens and non-spatial tokens. Recent analyses suggest that non-spatial register tokens encode global scene properties such as illumination, blur, and style.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Neurograf v1: An End-to-End Romanian-First Language Model Family
stories.summary: We present Neurograf v1, an experimental end-to-end Romanian-first language-model pipeline developed to investigate the feasibility of training language models from scratch for a lower-resource European language.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Mind the Spatial Gap: A Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning and Constrained Spatial Editing
stories.summary: Understanding and manipulating spatial relations is fundamental to AI systems that reason about physical environments and construct grounded world models.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: TAME-Nav: Temporal Asymmetric Mixture-of-Experts Distillation for Agile and Versatile Robot Navigation
stories.summary: Agile and reliable navigation is a core capability for embodied robots navigating complex spatial constraints and dynamic interactions. However, a single policy often struggles to accommodate the distinct decision-making demands of diverse scenarios.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: The Predictability Bias of Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning in Medical Imaging
stories.summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn by predicting teacher representations of masked regions from visible context. Point prediction summarizes the conditional target distribution and cannot reproduce variation that the context does not resolve.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Structural Automata for Neural Semantic Parsing
stories.summary: Neural semantic parsers generate meaning representations token by token, yet well-formedness depends on references, scope, and graph relations that unfold during generation.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Faithfulness Without Anchors: A Position Paper on the Structural Misalignments of Explainable AI Faithfulness Metrics for Feature Importance
stories.summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) tools have often been presented as methods to increase trust in machine learning models by making aspects of their algorithms more human-understandable.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: TTS-Q: Perception-Guided Post-Training Quantization of Text-to-Speech Diffusion Transformers
stories.summary: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) can clone a voice from seconds of audio. Yet the quality comes from billion-parameter diffusion transformers whose size and multi-step sampling put them out of reach of the on-device, assistive, and real-time applications that need them most.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Transformer-based In-Context Score Operator Learning for Diffusion Models
stories.summary: Diffusion models typically learn the generative dynamics of a single target distribution or a family of distributions indexed by conditioning variables fixed during training. This limits their ability to adapt to a previously unseen distribution from only a small set of examples.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Coordinate-Free Automatic Differentiation
stories.summary: Automatic differentiation (AD) is a cornerstone of modern machine learning. Since all AD frameworks implicitly fix a basis of Euclidean space to define gradients and Jacobians, they natively process mathematical objects that are arrays of a fixed set of coordinates.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Hidden Data Challenges in Clinical Machine Learning
stories.summary: Widely reused preprocessing pipelines for electronic health records can encode assumptions about when information became available, what clinical episode a label represents, and what missingness means.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Benchmarking Embedding Geometries and Clustering Algorithms for Unsupervised Patent Claim Classification
stories.summary: Prior-art retrieval systems are structurally organized around classification codes, making cross-code discovery difficult.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: How Reliable are AMR Parser Outputs? Uncertainty Estimation for AMR Parsing
stories.summary: Recent advances have significantly improved the performance of Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) parsers, yet determining when their outputs can be trusted remains largely unexplored.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Toward Maximizing Algebraic Connectivity via Density-Dependent Backbone Construction and Reinforcement Learning Completion
stories.summary: This paper studies an open network design problem of constructing graph topologies with maximum algebraic connectivity under fixed numbers of vertices and edges.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Beyond Binary Verifiable Rewards: Behavioral Self-Rewarding for SWE Agents
stories.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable supervision for software engineering agents through executable tests, but binary rewards fail to distinguish trajectories with substantially different debugging quality.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: SplatQ: Interaction-Aware Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splatting via Quadratic Selection
stories.summary: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pruning methods primarily rely on global Top-K selection based on independent importance scores, lacking regional budget control and ignoring joint deletion effects.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: When Generative Models Act as Simulators
stories.summary: A simulator summarizes an environment in a state that users can read and change. Generative models learn representations of the world without explicit specification, but offer no built-in way to edit that world's state.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Shift-Aware Identity-Guided Latent Refinement for Referring Audio--Visual Segmentation
stories.summary: Referring Audio--Visual Segmentation (Ref-AVS) is an emergent multimodal task requiring the precise identification and segmentation of a specific object based on a natural language expression grounded in both visual and auditory cues.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Reinforcement Learning via Fixed-point Flow Matching
stories.summary: In maximum entropy and behavior-constrained reinforcement learning (RL), the optimal policy is given by a Boltzmann distribution. Generating samples from this distribution can be challenging, as it is often complex and multimodal.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Volume Rendering with Metric--Phase Fields for Thin Structures and Sign-Ambiguous Geometry
stories.summary: Neural implicit surface methods that couple volume rendering with signed distance functions (SDFs), such as VolSDF and NeuS, achieve high-quality multi-view reconstruction for watertight objects.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
stories.summary: Machine-learning models for perovskite solar cells are typically evaluated using random data splits, which we show systematically leak information through massive internal duplication.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Does Financial Speech Need Continual Learning Regularization? A Study of EWC and mini-KFAC on Earnings Call ASR
stories.summary: Earnings call transcription presents a realistic continual learning scenario where Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems are updated with new recordings but risk catastrophic forgetting of previously learned financial speech patterns.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: MHR-Router: Multimodal Heterogeneous Retrieval-Enhanced Adaptive Routing for VLM Inference
stories.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit complementary capabilities, yet selecting the most suitable expert for a given image-question query remains challenging due to heterogeneous multimodal inputs and varying expert strengths.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Scaling Multi-Teacher Distillation for Digital Pathology
stories.summary: Multi-teacher distillation allows transferring knowledge from multiple "teacher" networks to a single "student" network. This method is promising in fields such as digital pathology, where many powerful foundation models were proposed recently.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: S$^3$R: Fast and Faithful RL Rollouts via Self-Sparse Speculative Decoding
stories.summary: Fast rollout generation for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) requires reducing KV-cache traffic without changing the response groups used for policy optimization.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Co-Modifying Application Code and Deployment Infrastructure: A Causal Study of AI Agent Pull Requests
stories.summary: Current software engineering agents are evaluated predominantly inside isolated sandboxes against synchronous local tests.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Robust and Scalable UAV-UGV Planning for Aerial Monitoring under Energy and Precedence Constraints
stories.summary: We consider planning for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) teams in aerial monitoring missions with ordering requirements on the monitoring points to be visited by the UAV.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: ROSETTA: Rotation Subspace Estimation for Training-free Transmodal Alignment
stories.summary: When a query must be matched against a database built with a different sensor or processed by a different encoder, the independently trained encoders impose distinct coordinate systems on the feature space.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Improving Semantic Coverage in AI Test & Evaluation through Generative Augmentation
stories.summary: In test and evaluation (T&E) of AI models, evaluators typically have access only to a held-out test dataset and no knowledge of the training data or its semantic composition.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: SWE-Duel: Towards a Self-Scaling Arena for Coding Agents
stories.summary: Static coding benchmarks are fixed at release. Over time their tasks leak into training data, and stronger agents eventually saturate them.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: OWLET: On-Policy Weighted Learning via Evidence Transfer for Video Large Language Model Post-Training
stories.summary: Post-training has become a key stage for eliciting reasoning capabilities in Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs). Existing post-training methods mainly follow two paradigms: reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD).
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Universal Bounds for Self-Normalized Kullback-Leibler Estimation
stories.summary: This work studies an entropy-based estimator of Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence constructed from normalized importance weights.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: High-Throughput Generative Video Super-Resolution on a Single Consumer GPU
stories.summary: Generative video super-resolution (VSR) can recover visually compelling high-frequency detail by leveraging diffusion priors, but iterative sampling and heavy spatio-temporal coupling make practical deployments difficult.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Competence-Aware Orchestration for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
stories.summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing complex reasoning through role specialization and collaboration, yet a key challenge remains: how can collaboration be adapted to a backbone's competence on the current query?
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Constrained Probabilistic Numerics: Gaussian Process Solvers for Linear PDEs under Linear Inequality Constraints
stories.summary: Gaussian process solvers for linear partial differential equations (PDEs) return posteriors rather than point estimates, but they condition only on equality information: the PDE residual, boundary data, and measurements.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Unsupervised Multimodal Reward Modeling
stories.summary: Vision-language reward models are trained on annotated preference pairs, which are expensive to collect, can disagree, and are ranked by benchmark accuracy.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: Taking Tokenization off the Host for Agentic LLM Serving
stories.summary: Agentic workloads resend long contexts that barely change between calls. Prefix caching now skips most of their prefill, yet every request must still be tokenized in full before the cache can even be consulted.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: SWE-DeceptionBench: Benchmarking Deceptive Behaviors of LLMs Across the Software Development Lifecycle
stories.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used throughout the software development lifecycle. This growing reliance on LLMs raises concerns about their trustworthiness, with deception posing a particularly important risk.
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: A4-MR: Abnormality-aware Anatomical Alignment for MR
stories.summary: Recent advances in large-scale foundation models have enabled strong generalization across a wide range of clinical and research tasks in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).
stories.whyItMatters: arXiv paper, first version published Oct 12, 2026.

stories.title: SWE-Critix: Post-Training Generalist Verifiers for Assessing Coding-Agent Trajectories
